name: Eight of Swords
keywords: a gap to slip out through

facts.bound-blindfold: A woman in red stands with her eyes covered and her upper body and arms bound with cloth.
facts.eight-swords: Eight swords are stuck in the ground around the woman (three on the left, five on the right).
facts.open-front: The swords are on both sides and behind, and the space in front of the woman is not blocked.
facts.legs-free: The cloth is wrapped only around the upper body, and the legs are free.
facts.castle: A castle can be seen on a hill at the back right.
facts.puddles: Pools of water have gathered on the ground under her feet.

glosses.legs-free: More freedom to move remains than she thinks.
glosses.open-front: There is a gap to slip out through, but she cannot see it.

reversedGloss.waning: The thoughts that bound her loosen, and an exit shows.
reversedGloss.excess: Fear grows, and she cannot move even more.

misdescriptions.wrong: She is completely surrounded by swords and trapped.
misdescriptions.regex: \bcompletely (?:surrounded|trapped|enclosed|encircled|boxed in)\b|\bsurrounded (?:on all sides|completely)\b|\bno (?:way|exit|escape) (?:out|at all)\b|\bswords (?:on|from) (?:all|every) sides?\b|\benclosed by (?:the )?swords\b

misdescriptions.wrong: Even her feet are tightly bound.
